verdict.rationale: Retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for a cloud note-taking app, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents retention settings, account or space deletion, or how AI-processed data is purged. The nearby evidence covers adjacent features only: AI opt-in governs third-party sharing, not retention or deletion; scheduled exports are about portability; and version history is about restoring content. None of these earn credit for this story.
